plan: A boy and his yeti who roll a giant snowball to knock up their enemies.
aSurveiller: His W (Biggest Snowball Ever!). The longer it rolls, the more it hurts and knocks you up: step out of its path.
contrer: Step out of the way of his snowball (W): you can see it coming.
Interrupt his R with crowd control: he has to channel it.
Get out of his R fast: otherwise you take a big explosion.
forces: Engages from far with his snowball.
His R deals big area damage.
faiblesses: His snowball is easy to see coming.

sorts.P: Empowers Willump and a nearby ally.
sorts.W: Snowball that grows and knocks up.

momentFort: Strong early in the jungle. He reaches level 6 quickly, a big advantage for the first fights.
